title: Diffusion
caption: Particles move randomly, so a gas released in one corner spreads until it is evenly mixed: there is a net movement from high to low concentration even though no single particle aims anywhere.
alt: Before: bromine molecules crowded on the left of a box of air. After: bromine spread evenly through the box.
description: Before: bromine (brown) only in the left half.
After a while: bromine everywhere, mixed with the air.
